postText:
Pew just dropped a survey. 36% of Americans think China is ahead on AI. Only 12% think the US is.

That's a wild number on its own. But what got me is India isn't even part of the question.

We're probably the biggest AI user base on the planet right now. Every second person on my feed is using ChatGPT, Gemini, something. Consumption is insane.

But building? That's a different story.

51% of Americans in that same survey said AI will increase the gap between rich and poor countries. More than half. And I think they're right, tbh.

Because here's the thing. If you're only using the tools, someone else is capturing the value. The model, the data, the infrastructure. None of that is ours.

India has the users, has the engineers, has the problems worth solving. We're not short on any of that.

I don't have a clean answer for why the builder story hasn't caught up to the user story yet. Still trying to figure that out honestly.

But if the gap is gonna widen, I'd rather be on the side making the thing.

#Opinion #TechTakes #SharpTakes
